[LFAC.8.6] **`SchemaDef`↔metadata round trip.** A conforming compiler must be
exercised by a fixture that compiles each schema kind in the slot-
type matrix [RDSC.5.8.6] states, loads the resulting `.dsc`
artefact, and asserts that the `SchemaDef` atom's
`proto_source` agrees with the `Slot` atoms field-by-field
([LFAC.8.5]: the `.proto` describes slots only): every slot in the `.proto`
appears as a `Slot` atom whose kind takes the field's type
([RDSC.5.8.7]), and vice versa. The test fails on
any unidirectional entry (`Slot` without `.proto`
field, or `.proto` field without `Slot`). This makes
the [LFAC.8.5] invariant mechanically checkable
rather than asserted by inspection. Runtime-side
fixture lives at
[RDSC.5.8.6].
